This plot is very small, only a tiny corner really, and I grow something other than my main crops here — I keep it close to the house where I can watch it. Since it is so small, buying a whole bag of fertilizer just for this piece does not make sense for me; I would rather put the manure from my animals here because it costs me nothing. I use the seed I saved from last season like my neighbors do, and I weed it myself when I go to fetch water. The rains come when they come, I have no way to water it, and I do not spray anything on this little patch.
